messages:
elaine: FYI, after the regional L7 inspection rollout in eu-west-1 our gpu warm pool is stuck. about ~95 GPUs failing to finish onboarding. Seeing repeated `egress denied` in node logs and KMS grant timeouts.

jorge: Confirmed. New inspection policy added `block-non-approved-egress` to provisioner SG. It inadvertently blocks the auditshipper private endpoint and the hsm proxy.

elaine: Log excerpt from one warm node:

```
2024-05-03T14:02:11Z ERROR network egress denied: dest=audit.internal.redwood:443 policy=block-non-approved-egress
2024-05-03T14:02:17Z WARN kms grant fetch failed: http 403
2024-05-03T14:02:30Z INFO warmpool join attempt=4/8 status=waiting
```

deploy-bot: rollout/inspection-policy v2024.05.03 deployed to eu-west-1 by infra-team @infra at 2024-05-03T13:58Z :white_check_mark:

security-bot: policy-change detected: inspection-l7 v2024.05.03. Attach approval-id=APPR-9231.

jorge: Quick mitigation options: 
1) Add a scoped allowlist for the auditshipper and hsm-proxy FQDNs in the policy (ephemeral)
2) Route auditshipper traffic via a dedicated NAT gateway (will increase egress spend)
3) Rollback the policy in region to previous version.

elaine: Cost math from finance: NAT egress for the expected QPS to finish onboarding (95 GPUs, ~10k requests/min) estimated ~ $380/hr for eu-west-1. Rolling back the policy has lower direct cost but delays the inspection rollout.

jorge: Security wants minimal blast radius. Proposed plan: ephemeral allowlist + short canary (15 nodes). If canary passes, progressively re-open more nodes while we instrument L7 exceptions in policy. Need security signoff and a documented justification.

elaine: I opened a PR with ipset entries + runbook steps: https://redwood.internal/infra/pulls/1987 (draft). It includes smoke script `scripts/check-auditshipper.sh` and expected JSON response.

sre-oncall: Oncall here. I'll divert new provisioning traffic to us-west-2 for 2 hours to reduce customer impact and keep an eye on `gpu.provisioning_success_rate`. Also setting alert: `gpu.warmpool.join_rate < 0.7 for 10m`.

security-bot: Reminder: ephemeral exceptions must be logged to audit and include business justification. Add `temp_allow_reason` tag in PR and ping SecOps.

elaine: Adding the required audit note in PR. Also adding a post-action item to run a quick compliance check: verify logs show the exception and that no unexpected hosts used the allowlist.

jorge: If anyone objects to the allowlist we can fallback to rollback. tagging @security and @infra for immediate review.

finance: Noted on cost. If we do NAT egress route instead of allowlist, please set a max spend window and notify me to cap the budget.

elaine: Will update thread after canary. Keeping timeline here for post-mortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
